68ecf915-1b32-4a0e-8d0d-190c853c0f05.content: How to organize a digital phonebank for campaign donations?

A digital phonebank leverages distributed volunteer power to secure small-dollar donations through personal outreach. Success relies on high-quality donor lists, clear scripts, and a centralized platform to track real-time progress.

strategy_data.summary: A digital phonebank leverages distributed volunteer power to secure small-dollar donations through personal outreach. Success relies on high-quality donor lists, clear scripts, and a centralized platform to track real-time progress.

actionSteps.title: Select and Configure Platform
actionSteps.description: Choose a peer-to-peer texting or phonebanking tool (e.g., Spoke, ThruTalk, or Hubdialer) that integrates with your CRM to ensure data flows directly into your donor database.

actionSteps.title: Develop Script and Training Materials
actionSteps.description: Draft a concise, conversational script that emphasizes the campaign's mission and a specific donation ask. Create a 15-minute training video or slide deck for volunteers.

actionSteps.title: Recruit and Onboard Volunteers
actionSteps.description: Send an email blast to your existing volunteer list inviting them to a virtual 'Kickoff & Training' session. Assign shifts and provide access credentials to the phonebanking software.

actionSteps.title: Execute and Monitor
actionSteps.description: Host the phonebank session. Use a Slack channel or Zoom room for real-time support, troubleshooting, and morale-boosting. Track metrics like 'calls made' and 'dollars raised' hourly.
